title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 14 Walnut Street in Bordentown, New Jersey, as the Clara Barton Post Office Building.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 14 Walnut Street in Bordentown, New Jersey, as the "Clara Barton Post Office Building."

summary.headline: A federal law renamed a New Jersey post office in Bordentown as the Clara Barton Post Office Building.
summary.what_it_does: This law gives an official name to the Postal Service facility at 14 Walnut Street in Bordentown, New Jersey. The new name is the Clara Barton Post Office Building. It does not change mail service, postal rules, or the building's operations.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 5, 2021.
